coverage.gaps: Read the PR list since 'since' (15 PRs, under the 100 limit) and every inline review comment on them, plus the #304 description and file list. Not read in this bounded run: PR diffs, review summary bodies, CI runs, the factory-state/visual-repair branch, tests and live-play notes.

proposals.title: Check that drawn geometry, hit tests and reported outcomes share one source
proposals.change: Add a lens for canvas code under src/ (games, midway, workshop): for every drawn part that the player can click, drag or watch move, check that its pointer hit area, its movement logic and any reported outcome are computed from the same geometry as the drawing, and flag anything hidden but still hittable, or drawn but not connected to what it is said to drive.
proposals.rationale: On #283 the first review let through drawing/logic mismatches (the frog not following the cam, the bell rod staying fixed while its lever turned, hit tests using radius circles instead of the drawn gear outline) that later review rounds found one at a time, costing several extra rounds. #263 had the same class: a hidden gift that still intercepted clicks. src/workshop/** is outside the carnival-house-rules lens globs, and no lens names this check.

decisions.rationale: Delayed recording of the18:00 assessment after approval. Current main still configures house rules only for src/games and has no dedicated drawn-geometry agreement lens for workshop/midway. Independent recorded PR283 and263 findings support the gap despite repairs to those examples. Additive lens only; no weakening. This decision does not endorse the disputed17:40 complete-coverage claim or execute its correction.

proposals.title: Require a short viewport capture for screens with fixed or stacked overlay panels
proposals.change: In 'What counts as evidence', after the desktop (1280x800) and narrow (390px) widths, add: when the change adds or moves fixed, absolute or stacked overlay panels (such as the midway's waterside, stones or ferry panels), also capture a short viewport (590x378, as at 200% browser zoom) and report a finding when a panel covers the toolbar or another control, or cannot be scrolled into view; without that capture the state is rendering unverified.
proposals.rationale: On #257 review caught panels covering each other, but not the stack growing over the Help, Guide, Photo and map view toolbar on a short, zoomed viewport; live QA found it and #262 had to repair it with watersideMaxHeight. The visual-design lens (added in #304) still only asks for desktop and narrow widths, so the same overlap on short screens would still pass review.
